data.description: Safety benchmark for evaluating LLM safety across hazard categories, developed by the MLCommons AI Safety Working Group.
data.notes: AILuminate defines hazard categories for LLM safety evaluation. Hazard categories are identified by slug names. Published with an accompanying arXiv paper.

versions_available.note: First edition of AILuminate safety benchmark.

data._item_pattern_note: Item-level IDs — AILuminate hazard category slug — are not yet enumerated. A catch-all pattern ^[A-Za-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$ was removed 2026-08-13: it matched any arbitrary token, fabricating resolution results for unrelated queries and polluting free-text search. Prior research note: Conceptual taxonomy — hazard categories defined in the AILuminate benchmark. No per-item URLs. Restore an item-level match_node once the real identifier list is confirmed (prefer known_values over an open pattern).
